## What's Changed
* Check a batched RPC edit's precondition against the batch's edits by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9675
* Record the Gradle build file on the GradleProject marker by @shanman190 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9652
* C#: republish a recipe bundle rebuilt under the same version by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9693


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.99.1...v8.100.0

## What's Changed
* Count an unresolved import of a type as a use of it in UsesType by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9664
* Batch an RPC scan only for files its scanner would visit by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9669
* Skip the LST walk in file-level recipes for non-matching files by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9672
* Prevent recipes from keeping visitors as static fields as that's not thread-safe by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9671
* Keep comments about surrounding code when RemoveBuildPlugin removes a plugin by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9674
* Remove unused `ClassIdResolver` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9676
* Keep diamond, constructed class import and literals in InlineMethodCalls by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9677
* JavaScript: export LST helpers that downstream recipes re-implement by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9679
* Static visitor check - skip recipes from dependencies by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9681


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.99.0...v8.99.1

## What's Changed
* Map a varargs method reached through reflection with the Varargs flag by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9663
* Let computeMessageIfAbsent's function call views that store messages by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9665
* C#: keep RpcFixture at the RPC server's default page size by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9666
* Python: keep an added import below the imports isort pins in place by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9667
* Only generate gradle.properties for a Gradle project by @shanman190 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9588


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.98.0...v8.99.0

## What's Changed
* Gradle AddDependency: upgrade existing dependency when version is lower by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9515


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.97.2...v8.98.0

## What's Changed
* JavaScript: fix infinite recursion in scanner gated by a serializable… by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9614
* JavaScript: refuse a recipe package whose peer range excludes the host by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9610
* Python: read the uv.lock spellings uv reads, and name the conflict-gated requirements the engine does not model by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9574
* Go: align Statement and Expression kinds and visitor dispatch with Java by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9615
* Remove unused whitespaceSuffixPattern from Java parser visitors by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9613
* JavaScript: print a YAML scalar's anchor before its tag by @myhau in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9619
* JavaScript: YAML flow scalars keep their line breaks and escapes by @myhau in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9618
* JavaScript: print the tag of a YAML mapping or sequence by @myhau in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9625
* JavaScript: keep text after the last YAML document by @myhau in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9626
* Python: declare the license as an SPDX expression to drop the setuptools deprecation warning by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9617
* Keep Kotlin's SpacesVisitor stop flag off the shared root cursor by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9622
* Fail tests that add to the recipes that made changes in a cycle by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9623
* Write inferred intersection types as their first bound in JavaTemplate parameter stubs by @motlin in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9627
* Load the tooling plugin at the model's own version by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9630
* Python: ChangeImport moves an import inside a function, `try` or `else` branch by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9629
* Keep setuptools' egg-info out of rewrite-python's test inputs by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9621
* Honor declared package manager when selecting JavaScript lock files by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9548
* Ship SharedMavenPomCacheExtension in rewrite-maven's main artifact by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9637
* Read the Code Genome Project credential from ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_ variables in the tooling init script by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9639
* Support coordinated dependency upgrades with checked npm peer recovery by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9640
* Preserve RPC recipe cycles across scan, generate and edit by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9641
* Compare receivers of Kotlin extension calls in semantic equality by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9633
* Preserve NaN semantics when negating ordered comparisons by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9644
* JavaScript: improve readability of tests - real line breaks instead of raw `\n` by @myhau in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9634
* Preserve unboxing in Java boolean simplification by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9645
* Use the control cursor when aligning multiline for headers by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9646
* Preserve operand evaluation in boolean simplification by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9648
* Support bounded PNPM 10 native lock regeneration by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9647
* Measure multiline for headers from the updated loop tree by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9649
* Handle deleted top-level if statements in scripts by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9650
* Skip Gradle build files without a GradleProject marker in UpgradeTransitiveDependencyVersion by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9654
* JavaScript printers: a marker on a container encloses its delimiters by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9653
* JavaScript: pattern debug output shows where and why a match fails by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/6316
* C#: await tasks in tests instead of blocking on them by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9655
* Route recipe repositories' tests through the Maven Central mirror by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9657
* JavaScript: add onlyIfResolving to AddDependency by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9658

## New Contributors
* @motlin made their first contribution in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9627

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.97.1...v8.97.2

## What's Changed
* Share scanning recipe state with RPC edit visitors by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9552
* C#: template parenthesization follow-ups for conditionals, null-forgiving ! and capture ids by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9553
* C#: format a file that leaves its namespace's members flush as the file indents by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9554
* JavaScript: visit type positions as Java does, type template parameters fully, and read a child's own slot by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9555
* Python: rewrite_run reports output that doesn't parse as such, not as added markers by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9556
* Python: indent formatted code as the file does when no style says how by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9557
* Python: a parameter's default value takes spaces only after an annotation by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9558
* Go: AutoFormat follow-ups toward gofmt by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9559
* Kotlin: templates parenthesize with Kotlin's precedence by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9560
* Groovy: a template parenthesizes a cast operand as Groovy reads it by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9561
* Scala: templates parenthesize with Scala's precedence by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9562
* Python: a template replacement keeps the blank lines before the code it replaces by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9563
* JavaScript: preserve semicolon of labeled statement used as control flow body by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9514
* Python: empty `after` to match only empty output by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9564
* Scala: Making Java's `RemoveImport` not crash on member imports in Scala code by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9567
* JavaScript: preserve directive prologues when adding imports by @myhau in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9566
* Name the hbase-shaded-client fixture configuration as a test configuration by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9570
* JavaScript: allow string literal module export names in `JS.Alias` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9568
* Retain versions no longer managed through a BOM imported by `spring-boot-dependencies` by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9581
* Test on the Java 25 parser in modules whose tests now run on JDK 25 by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9585
* Default the Tooling API to Gradle 9.8.2 by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9587
* Groovy: parse comment-only lines before static star imports by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9549
* Groovy: preserve lazy closures in GString interpolation by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9551
* Migrate project source-set dependencies safely for Gradle 9 by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9576
* Groovy: consume spread-map entry values once by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9550
* Gradle 9: merge Manifest attributes through the supported API by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9569
* Fix `RemoveImport` trailing comma loss and module-to-script breakage by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9577
* JavaScript: share the host's @openrewrite/rewrite with symlinked recipe packages by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9595
* Migrate Shadow plugin declarations for Gradle 9 by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9592
* Honor explicit overrides of inherited managed plugin versions by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9593
* Handle Kotlin DSL when changing Gradle dependency configurations by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9594
* JavaScript: decode escapes in JSON keys from `getMemberKeyName` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9597
* JavaScript: add `onlyIfDeclaring` to `AddDependency` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9601
* JavaScript: record GetObject metrics when the RPC server serves from its worker by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9603
* JavaScript: ChangeMethodTargetToImport takes the import style by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9604
* JavaScript: stop the RPC worker transport from leaving a GetObject unanswered by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9606
* Decode escapes in JSON string literal values by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9605
* HCL: lex unicode escapes and decode escapes in literal values by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9607
* TOML: decode escapes in quoted key names by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9608
* Keep a method's type parameters in JavaReflectionTypeMapping on JDK 25 by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9598
* JavaScript: match and rebind string-literal import names in `maybeRebind` and `maybeBind` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9612
* RemoveRedundantProperties: keep a module's override of a property only local POMs define by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9600
* ChangeMethodName: don't rename a declaration when the class already declares the new method by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9599
* Keep a line comment added by the Comments trait from swallowing an element that shares its line by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9611
* Gradle UpgradeDependencyVersion: don't declare a plugin's own tooling dependencies by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9602
* JavaScript: resolve an installed recipe package's shared dependencies from the host by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9609
* Python: name a poetry.lock written before Poetry 2.0 by its lock-version by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9575


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.97.0...v8.97.1

## What's Changed
* Change Gradle plugin IDs in Kotlin build and settings scripts by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9526
* C#: RewriteTest takes an .editorconfig among a test's sources by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9538
* JavaScript: template and visitor follow-ups from #9530 by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9540
* JavaScript: the templating tests leave comparing with a fresh parse to rewriteRun by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9541
* Python: a template replacement keeps the indentation of the line it starts by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9542
* Python: the JVM tests run again when a Python source changes by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9543
* Go: the formatter returns the nodes it doesn't change by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9544
* ParenthesizeVisitor: keep parentheses around an equally binding right operand by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9545
* C#: parenthesize template captures as the parser reads them, and give each template result its own ids by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9537
* Migrate mixed configuration spreads and legacy archive classifiers by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9531
* Go: a formatter recipe's self-test runs with the tree-identity check on by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9546
* Fix native JavaScript lock regeneration and atomic dependency edits by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9524
* C#: indent formatted code as the file does when .editorconfig doesn't say by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9539
* Delete a dependency workspace whole or not at all, reuse one only with its dependencies installed, and age it from its last use by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9547
* Wait for the classpath scan when several threads first use one Environment at once by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9522


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.96.5...v8.97.0

## What's Changed
* Fix merging YAML entries from immutable lists by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9525
* JavaScript: a pattern matches parentheses only where it has them too by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9527
* Python: build template results as the parser reads their text by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9528
* C#: build template results as the parser reads them, and let AutoFormat indent new elements by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9529
* JavaScript: build template results as the parser reads them, and format a file with a bare yield by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9530
* Python: rewrite_run runs Java's recipe quality checks by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9532
* JavaScript: rewriteRun runs Java's recipe quality checks by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9533
* Go: RewriteRun runs Java's recipe quality checks by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9534
* C#: RewriteTest runs Java's recipe quality checks by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9535


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.96.4...v8.96.5

## What's Changed
* Go: test harness improvements by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9510
* Fix JsonPath YAML recipes crashing on aliases of block mapping anchors by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9512
* MergeYaml: keep file header and `---` on top when inserting before the first key by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9496

## What's Changed
* JavaScript: AddImport `onlyIfReferenced` ignores a name the file already binds by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9480
* Go: in tests run AfterRecipe on the recipe result instead of the parsed tree by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9481
* JavaScript: fail `rewriteRun` on generated files no spec describes by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9482

* KotlinTemplate: wrap substituted expressions placed as statements by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9488
* JavaTemplate: keep the comments of a substituted parameter by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9492
* Do not downgrade Java versions referenced through compiler properties by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9493
* Groovy: parse unary plus and minus as J.Unary by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9499

* Go: remove unused WithJavaRecipe test hook and Java RPC test client by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9485
* Go: declare Java sources and test data as `goTest` inputs by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9503
* Go: fix cursor assertion failures in rewrite-go integTests by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9504
* JavaScript: reset the RPC factory after tests that point it at a @TempDir by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9505
* Don't let AddPluginDependency downgrade an existing plugin dependency by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9461
* Python: add data_table assertions to tests by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9508
* JavaTemplate: keep a replaced tree's comments once when it is passed back in by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9494
* KotlinTemplate: support replaceParameters() and replaceTypeParameters() by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9495
* Kotlin: keep comments before an expression body on the expression by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9497
* Keep a trailing closure in GradleDependency edits by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9458
* Keep a POM's own inherited=false plugins in its resolved model by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9460
* Update only the version when AddPluginDependency upgrades a plugin dependency by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9506
* C#: rewriteRun test framework to run the recipe at least twice to ensure idempotency by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9509

## What's Changed
* Stop loading recipe examples and maintainers by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9449
* Keep the types of the parsers a test builds in a HashMap by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/9450

name: v8.84.2
body:
## What's Changed
* Scala: handle parsing String interpolation with a non-empty prefix by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7908
* Scala: fix parsing of return types written in parens by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7909
* Let callers opt out of the GitProvenance committer-history walk by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7910
* Scala: handle case guards with complex (block) conditions by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7913
* Go: make sure go.mod is emitted as GoMod source by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7914
* Scala: ScalaSpace class for handling nesting comments by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7915
* Scala: fix too optimistic matching of `???` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7916
* Scala: fix spacing before underscore parameter by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7912
* rewrite-csharp: rename XmlRecipeActivator to CoreCSharpRecipeActivator and drop example recipes by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7917


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.84.1...v8.84.2

## What's Changed
* Give the NullSafe marker a Jackson creator so it round-trips by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7879
* rewrite-kotlin: extend recipe DSL `rewrite { } to { }` arity from 2 to 12 by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7890
* JavaScript: tolerate MethodDeclarations without dimensionsAfterName by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7891
* JavaScript: don't try to install RPC recipes by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7892
* rewrite-kotlin: re-expose Java instance methods Kotlin's mapped-type customizer hides by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7893
* 8.83.5 regression: RocksdbMavenPomCache fails to deserialize stale POM cache entries by @benjaminknauer in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7887
* npm-publish: also publish for manual `ci` dispatches on main by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7886
* rewrite-kotlin: variadic-by-default matching in the recipe DSL by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7895
* C#: decompose CsDocComment.DocComment over RPC via a proper visitor by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7894
* rewrite-csharp: preserve pragma whitespace and modifier-only lambda params by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7896
* Groovy: Disable AST transformations on the classpath that influence the shape of the code  by @gtiwari333 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7871
* Gradle: surface the real parse failure instead of an opaque ClassCastException by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7898
* Add BackwardCompatibleObjectIdModule so that we can adopt @JsonIdentityInfo annotations without breaking deserialization of old LSTs that lack the ref field. by @sambsnyd in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7897
* Renew expired OWASP suppressions to 2026-07-01 by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7899
* C#: Share `JavaType` cache across documents within a project by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7900
* C#: Stream RPC with `System.Text.Json` instead of `Newtonsoft` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7901
* Build data table descriptors from the cached recipe descriptor by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7876
* Set DOTNET_ROOT for the C# RPC apphost from the resolved dotnet by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7874
* Groovy: Fix parsing of generated code that contains ternery operator   by @gtiwari333 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7859
* C#: Deserialize recipe option values from JsonElement in PrepareRecipe by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7904
* Make MavenPomDownloaderTest hermetic with MockWebServer by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7905
* Groovy: reuse the classpath loader across files and skip the per-file global-transform scan by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7903
* rewrite-csharp: parse with latest SDK by neutralizing global.json pins by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7902

## New Contributors
* @gtiwari333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7871

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.84.0...v8.84.1

## What's Changed
* Go: visitor logic to traverse `go.mod` and test harness by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7864
* Scala: add public canonical all-args constructors to 6 S LST types by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7869
* JavaScript: Normalize `@types/<pkg>` to the importable specifier in transitively-resolved type names by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7868
* Return -1 for blank or null Java compatibility without throwing by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7872
* Kotlin recipe DSL v2 dispatch: route all-Java bodies to JavaVisitor by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7875
* Resolve RPC tree codec by canonical type for SourceFile subclasses by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7873
* Make `AdaptiveRadixTree` stack-safe (iterative search, insert, and copy) by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7878
* Recover the declaring package for bare top-level type names in the TypeScript parser by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7881
* Attribute internal export= namespaces by their importable package name (TypeScript parser) by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7882
* Richer TypeScript type attribution: decorators and type-alias names by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7883
* Break self-referential JavaType.Method attribution cycles via the type cache by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7877


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.83.7...v8.84.0

## What's Changed
* Groovy: parse untyped parameters whose names start with a modifier keyword by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7866
* Exclude synthetic parameters from constructor parameterNames in `JavaReflectionTypeMapping` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7867


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.83.6...v8.83.7

## What's Changed

## What's Changed
* Go: Fenced Marker Printer only to print SearchResults and Markup by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7812
* JavaScript: Java port of dependency-management recipes + resolved-deps overlay by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7795
* Regenerate recipes.csv for all modules (alphabetical sort) by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7816
* Fix StackOverflowError in Kotlin parser for deeply nested binary expressions by @zieka in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7083
* Fix main CI: exclude build-time gradle-api jar from tooling-API test manifest by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7818
* Keep a space between a leading annotation and a Kotlin variable name by @MBoegers in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7817
* Fix C-style array method declaration parsing by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/6992
* Gradle: sync `version { strictly(...) }` constraints when upgrading dependencies by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7810
* Scala: fix parsing of lambda within `{}` block by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7814
* Go: send `dimensionsAfterName` in `MethodDeclaration` RPC codec by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7823

* Go: Fix `nil` directive slices in `go.mod` producer by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7821
* Scala: fix parsing of closing parens, introduce positionOfMatchingClose by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7825
* Go: Refactor, split into java and golang packages by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7827
* Go: break import cycles in `ProjectImporter` to fix stack overflow by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7828
* Scala: fix parsing of a parenthesized expression before a {} block by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7826
* Go: Add missing `TypeParameters` to MethodDeclarations and TypeDecl by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7830
* Support proto2 groups in ProtoParser by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7829
* Go: Map type-set union constraints to rich `Go.Union` / `Go.UnderlyingType` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7824
* Fix YAML parser round-trip for block scalars and nested template placeholders by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7832
* Scala: fix parsing types with context bounds by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7835
* Go: fix `Print` panics from type-inferred RPC padding receive (empty imports, compound-assignment operators) by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7831
* Go: visitor to go into grouped declarations' specs by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7820
* Go: collapse receiver `q.Receive` boilerplate via generic `receiveValue` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7836
* Go: resolve composite recipes' `RecipeList()` children by name by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7837
* Go: fix `Print` panic on pointer-typed `*Container` NO_CHANGE receive (follow-up to #7831) by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7838
* Go: isolate reverse-RPC receive state so a mid-receive panic can't cascade by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7839
* Fix NPE in ProtoParser for fields named after keywords by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7841
* Go: map Go-specific operators to rich Go.* LST nodes so they survive RPC round-trips by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7842
* Type signature, marker, and SPI changes across rewrite-java and rewrite-maven by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7845


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.83.4...v8.83.5

* Go: call newObj on CHANGE with nil value by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7811
* JavaScript: spawn Java RPC server for TS integration tests by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7806
* Lazy single-recipe activation by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7807
* `RecipeMarketplaceWriter` to sort recipes alphabetically by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7815

name: v8.83.3
body:
## What's Changed
* Go: fix several cases of padding coercion in RPC by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7778
* Go: handle markers with no RPC codecs by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7776
* RenameVariable: skip type-reference identifiers in method signatures and casts by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7780
* Fix AddCommentToXmlTag for self-closing and empty tags by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7779
* Go: introduce JavaTypeShallowClass by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7782
* Go: don't pick the container variant off the first element by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7783
* Go: mutate objects in place in RPC receiver by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7785
* RemoveUnusedImports: keep imports used only in nested generics with partial type attribution by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7784
* Scala: fixing various cases of leading whitespace in brackets, etc. by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7756
* C#: skip dotnet restore for unmodified csproj during attestation by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7788
* C#: preserve whitespace in nullable directives and widen IsPattern by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7787
* Python: bump `ty-types` to 0.0.39, handle `EnumComplement` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7789
* Scala: fix for anonymous `using` context parameter by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7761
* TypeTable: tolerate cross-JVM races when publishing per-artifact JARs by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7786
* Python: fix DependencyWorkspace race on invalid leftover dir by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7790
* Scala: fix for parsing optional braces in a function expression by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7792
* Scala: fix for if expressions in new class by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7791
* Go: preserve elements' ids over RPC by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7794
* Scala: accept .sbt files and add sbt() test helper by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7793
* Go: default to new UUID for new objects by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7796
* Go: fix RPC handling of left padded operator enums by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7797
* Scala: fix printing of new-class with `with` intersection type by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7798
* Fix `FindEndOfLifeImagesTest` to suggest Node 26 or 24 by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7800
* Python: regenerate recipes.csv by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7801
* Scala: support for Scala 2 macro syntax by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7799
* Go: Add missing visitFallThrough to RPC by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7802
* C#: preserve whitespace in auto-property accessors and null-conditional assignments by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7803


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.83.2...v8.83.3

## What's Changed
* Scala: handle whitespace before asInstanceOf cast by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7758
* JUnit 6 best practices by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7766
* Go: handle type attribution for multi-return by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7767
* Go: tests to observe the markers added by a recipe in 'after' by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7768
* Default whitespace for keyword-prefixed JContainers in withX(...) mutators by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7769
* JavaTemplate: recurse into lambda bodies so coords-targeting-body actually apply by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7770
* Fix AddDependency no-op when libs.versions.toml is present on Gradle 9 by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7550


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.83.1...v8.83.2

## What's Changed
* Scala: amendments to import handling by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7760
* Publish to NPM directly by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7759
* RecipeClassLoader: child-load Kotlin recipe-DSL builder classes by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7763
* Refresh README: update Moderne section, links, and CLI thumbnail by @bryanfriedman in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7755
* Defer JUnit version selection to upstream convention plugin by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7762
* Remove rewrite-java-next module due to downstream issues by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7764
* Go: employ modfile for parsing go.mod files by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7765

## New Contributors
* @bryanfriedman made their first contribution in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7755

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.83.0...v8.83.1

## What's Changed
* Fix RemoveAnnotation crash on Groovy trees when rewrite-kotlin is on the classpath by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7720
* Kotlin recipe DSL: Java-static chain inner + bare-param after + trailing-lambda parens by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7723
* Revert inline Maven mirror (now in gh-automation#95) by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7724
* Kotlin recipe DSL: wrap generated visitors with UsesMethod/UsesField preconditions by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7725
* Groovy: preserve folded constant references in nested annotation arguments by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7722
* Pass --skip-existing to twine upload for Python snapshots by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7728
* Kotlin recipe DSL: preserve dot-on-its-own-line layout across chain collapse by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7729
* Scala: support for scala-xml parsing by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7727
* Semver: accept globs in metadataPattern; fix backpatch-style upgrades by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7731
* JavaScript: make `prettier` a devDependency to fix flaky npmBuild by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7735
* C#: fix InstallRecipes echoing wildcard versions in response.Version by @natedanner in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7697
* Scala: more fixes for braceless/indentation syntax by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7734
* Scala: fix parsing of whitespace after annotations by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7732
* Scala: support `_=>` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7733
* Support parsing Python 2.7 source through the existing parser pipeline by @bmuschko in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7678
* Kotlin recipe DSL: emit precise arg-count matcher patterns instead of (..) by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7737
* C#: restore legacy packages.config projects via NuGet CLI by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7726
* Scala: support for `given` and `using` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7738
* Scala: fix parsing of a block following a partial function by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7739
* Scala: enabling postfixOps compiler setting by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7740
* Add rewrite-java-next module for non-LTS JDK support by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7719
* Go: fix Javadoc references by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7745
* Scala: fix try catch single line default by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7744
* Scala: fix parameterless method declaration with type parameters by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7742
* Scala: fix printing of curried method declaration with default values by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7746
* Kotlin: normalise `kotlin.String` to `java.lang.String` for Java static-method params by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7747
* Scala: fix bodyless classes by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7748
* Provide JDK 26 toolchain for scheduled Gradle workflows by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7749
* Don't npm-publish other than releases or snapshots from main by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7750
* Go: revise the recipe installation procedure by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7743
* Scala: S.Import and support for rich import/export syntax by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7751
* Tolerate methods without an enclosing class in RemoveMethodThrows + handle Kotlin @Throws by @MBoegers in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7661
* Suppress gradleApi() transitive CVEs in rewrite-gradle-tooling-model:plugin by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7752
* Kotlin recipe DSL: preserve substituted args' interior whitespace across AutoFormat by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7753
* Scala: distinguish between annotated type and annotated expression by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7754
* Gradle: handle null resolved versions in UpgradePluginVersion (consolidates #7658) by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7656


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.82.1...v8.83.0

## What's Changed
* Kotlin recipe DSL: trailing-lambda parens + Java-static chain inner + bare-param after body by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7709
* Kotlin recipe DSL: drop `KotlinCompositeRecipe` bridge row from recipes.csv by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7710
* RecipeClassLoader: parent-delegate `@AbstractRecipe` by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7711

* Scala: fixes for parsing _ => false function by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7699
* Scala: add support for `with` syntax in intersection types by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7712
* Scala: fix underscore lambda detection by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7713
* Scala: introduce S.SplatExpression by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7714

* Kotlin recipe DSL: pattern-matching gap closures + matcher/template fixes by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7703

* Kotlin recipe DSL: chained-call patterns + cursor exposure in visitX actions by @jkschneider in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7708

name: v8.81.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Align ASM and Kotlin stdlib versions across modules by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7474
* UpgradeDependencyVersion: warn on install failure instead of throwing by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7479
* XML: recognize additional .NET XML file extensions by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7448
* Fix TypeTable round-trip for Kotlin top-level functions by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7422
* Improve AddDependency performance by reducing unnecessary scanning for types in use by @sambsnyd in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7482
* Resolve groovy multiline interpolation parse error by @vpa1977 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7430
* Add unit test for lombok.val by @sullis in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7481
* Groovy: fix parsing of a dynamic map key with parens by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7485
* Groovy: fix parsing of a method with array varargs by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7484
* Groovy: fix parsing of @Immutable @ToString by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7487
* Groovy: Fix NPE with generics of an unknown class by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7488
* Make Java compatibility tests not depend on java-tck JAR by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7489
* FindStyles: honor custom @JsonSerialize so ImportLayoutStyle.layout isn't dropped by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7486
* UpgradeDependencyVersion: pass --legacy-peer-deps to npm/pnpm by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7490
* Fix Groovy parser failure on nested annotations in list literals by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7492
* Groovy: fix parsing of method calls on int literals by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7493
* Groovy: support `@groovy.test.NotYetImplemented` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7494
* Kotlin: remap builtins on Java-origin method/field types by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7428
* Exclude `META-INF` for Gradle caching in Java compatibility tests by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7495
* Groovy: fix parsing method invocations with method names like `.classSomething` by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7496
* Groovy: fix parsing of explicit `super()` constructor call by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7497
* Groovy: add trait support by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7499
* Javadoc: preserve multi-line HTML comments inside block tags by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7500
* Groovy: fix parsing syntactic sugar of closure-call expressions by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7501
* Migrate 'main' property in MigrateToGradle9 by @sullis in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7504
* Groovy: fix parsing of command expressions with args in parens by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7503
* Groovy: fix parsing of generics class literal by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7505
* Groovy: more fixes to map key expressions with parens by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7507
* Groovy: fix parsing of property expressions in parens by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7506
* Groovy: fix parsing of negated new expression by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7508
* Restore JavaScript/Python/C# entries for Java recipes in recipes.csv by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7510
* Build fast "has type" lookup into TypesInUse cache, speeding up repeated type queries by @sambsnyd in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7483

## New Contributors
* @vpa1977 made their first contribution in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7430

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.81.0...v8.81.1

## What's Changed
* Skip `META-INF/` entries in classpath scanner by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7461
* Scala: public canonical ctors for `S.TuplePattern` and `S.FunctionCall` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7462
* Fix print idempotency for Javadoc `<pre><code>` blocks on Java 25 by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7464
* Add `Supplier<Path>` overloads to RPC builders for lazy tool-path resolution by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7465
* Fix YAML print idempotency for asterisk placeholders inside block scalars by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7466
* Fix GroovyParserVisitor crash on multi-variable field declarations by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7467
* During declarative recipe loading filter out duplicate copies of singleton recipes. by @sambsnyd in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7468
* Fix GroovyParserVisitor cast dispatch for parenthesized expressions by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7470
* Fix Kotlin parser handling of unresolved callable references by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7469
* JavaScript: Package Manager to return the same node resolution marker if no changes by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7473
* Use version pattern in `noDependencyManagementSection` test by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7475


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.80.1...v8.81.0

## What's Changed
* Scala: fix parsing of backtick-wrapped identifiers by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7440
* Register `JavaType.ShallowClass` codec on the Python RPC side by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7441
* C#: Improve TreeVisitor combining and handle null expression statements by @macsux in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7435
* Handle `J.SwitchExpression` in `BlockStatementTemplateGenerator` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7445
* Scala: pass `-parameters` to `javac` in joint compilation by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7449
* Scala: support `implicit` method parameters by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7450
* Scala: support for package objects by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7451
* Scala: fix handling of comments within cases by @greg-at-moderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7452
* Pin bouncycastle 1.84 in kotlinBouncyCastleConfiguration by @Jenson3210 in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7453
* Fix Scala parser losing type attribution when classpath lacks stdlib by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7446
* Share artifact cache across JavaSourceSetUpdater visitors by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7454
* Disable JAR downloading in JavaSourceSetUpdater by @steve-aom-elliott in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7459


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.80.0...v8.80.1

## What's Changed
* Python: bump ty-types to 0.0.31, consume new ParamSpec wire fields by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/7431

body:
## What's Changed

* Assign response from `withTypeParameters` in `SpacesVisitor` by @timtebeek in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5173
* `AdaptiveRadixTree`: Faster reads by using a bitmap index `Node64` by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5181
* `JavaTemplate`: Add support for match arrays by @fmodesto in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5170
* Update `HttpSender.Request.Builder` to support multipart/form-data request bodies with multiple parts by @bryceatmoderne in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5044

* `LatestPatch#isValid()` should allow pre-releases by @knutwannheden in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5192
* When no version is present, skip resolving by @Laurens-W in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5185

## New Contributors
* @fmodesto made their first contribution in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/5170

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.48.0...v8.48.1

body:

- Yaml IndentsVisitor now allows yaml comments to retain multiple newlines in their prefixes. by @sambsnyd in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/commit/3bf5b52e58458ad57a5c2141b3a6c39bdaaeeb06

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/compare/v8.37.3...v8.37.4

* Suppressing vulnerabilities by @pstreef in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/4572

* Added arrays to AddOrUpdateAnnotationAttribute by @marcel-gepardec in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/4446
* Add processing for nested modules with a parent version property by @marcel-gepardec in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/4472
* Support parsing the Metadata field in html using the XML parser by @lkerford in https://github.com/openrewrite/rewrite/pull/4573
